claim_text: Polynomial vs AIC h100: TTFT avg 67.3 vs 68.2 ms, p99 248 vs 307 ms, max 2540 vs 4518 ms.

adjudication.observed: poly: avg 67.30 ms, p99 248.46 ms, max 2539.91 ms; aic: avg 68.23 ms, p99 307.36 ms, max 4517.57 ms
adjudication.evidence: The dedicated view llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective confirms the values match exactly. The H100 attribution is correct as the Table 5.1 caption explicitly specifies the timing is calibrated to the h100_sxm profile.
adjudication.query: SELECT timing, effective_mean_ttft_ms AS avg_ttft, effective_p99_ttft_ms AS p99_ttft, effective_max_ttft_ms AS max_ttft FROM provenance.llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective;

adjudication.observed: poly: 67.30121881118457 / 248.46453200333053 / 2539.913656001503 ms; aic: 68.23317545340223 / 307.36447700019926 / 4517.568278000195 ms; each has 2000 requests in the single head2k window, is current and non-superseded, but gpu is null.
adjudication.evidence: All quoted values round correctly and denominators match, but v_pool_latency does not contain the averages and the DB provides no H100 hardware attribution because gpu is null for both runs.
adjudication.fix: Retain the rounded values but remove the H100 attribution unless hardware provenance is added; cite current_llm_summary or the effective view for the averages in addition to v_pool_latency.
adjudication.query:
WITH checked AS (
  SELECT r.converter AS timing, d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_requests,
         d.gpu, d.is_current, d.superseded_by,
         s.completed_requests, s.num_requests, s.mean_ttft_ms,
         p.p99_ms, p.max_ms, p.n_requests,
         e.effective_mean_ttft_ms, e.effective_p99_ttft_ms,
         e.effective_max_ttft_ms, e.effective_build
  FROM provenance.v_dim d
  JOIN provenance.runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.current_llm_summary s USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective e
    ON e.srcbuild_run_id = d.run_id AND e.timing = r.converter
  WHERE d.is_current = true
    AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND d.run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src', 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')
    AND p.is_current = true
    AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft'
)
SELECT timing, run_id, window_name, window_requests, gpu, is_current,
       superseded_by, completed_requests, num_requests, n_requests,
       mean_ttft_ms, p99_ms, max_ms,
       effective_mean_ttft_ms, effective_p99_ttft_ms,
       effective_max_ttft_ms, effective_build,
       count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY timing) AS per_timing_window_rows
FROM checked
ORDER BY timing
